product_metadata.title: Lawei Set of 6 Unbreakable Premium Drinking Glasses - 13 Oz Plastic Water Cups Stackable Tritan Tumbler Cups, BPA Free, Little Lightweight Beverage Glasses for Kids
features: Package Include: You will receive set of 6 beautiful colors drinking glasses, each cups measures 3.25 in (Top) x 2 in (Bottom) x 4.5 in (Height) water tumblers. With a capacity of 13 oz, ideal for your favorite cold drinks: juice, lemonade, fruit infused water, iced tea, iced coffee, punch, sangria, and more.

Premium Material: Lawei colored water drinking cups are made of high quality durable plastic, lead-free, food-grade, safe for daily use. No plastic smell, with high-efficiency crystal effect, not easy to break, and reassuringly heavy - with the look and feel of glass.

Attractive Design: Innovative dappled interior design prevents water tumblers sticking together when stacked. Tapered shape allow plastic tumbler cups stack nicely to save space. For both indoor and outdoor usage such as parties, patio, poolside, picnic, camping, washroom.

Dishwasher Safe: You can either hand wash these acrylic drinking glasses or put them in the dishwasher to save your time. Even if you use and wash the drinking tumblers daily, they will not get cloudy and lose its luxurious finish. Top rack dishwasher safe.

Multipurpose Use: They are perfect for cocktails like an old fashioned, whiskey or scotch, and they complement most parties, weddings and occasions too. Less breakage compared to glass tumblers while cheaper than crystal tumblers, suitable for the majority of consumer group. Great for gatherings, parties, barbecues.
